0022600094.text: The Hawks (1-0, 1st in the Southeast and 2nd in the East) are looking for their second win of the season after a 1-0 road start, while the Hornets open their 2026-27 season. The teams have no 2026-27 meetings yet, and the Hawks lost 1-3 to the Hornets in the 2025-26 season, including a 110-107 loss in Charlotte on February 11, 2026. Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Charlotte is missing Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee).
